sources.title: [26.13] OTP Master Talon Guide with All combos / Season 16
Talon Jungle | Master & Below – S16 S2 | Patch 26.16

passive.name: Blade's End
passive.text: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

spells.name: Noxian Diplomacy
spells.text: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.

spells.name: Rake
spells.text: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.

spells.name: Assassin's Path
spells.text: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.

spells.name: Shadow Assault
spells.text: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.

damage.value: Talon deals physical damage with Rake and Shadow Assault, while Blade's End adds sustained bleed damage.

archetype.value: Talon is an assassin who chains abilities and attacks to proc his passive.

axis.value: Talon favors short, hit-and-run fights built around his burst damage.

winCondition.value: Talon wins by proccing his passive, catching enemies out of position, and flanking around objectives.

spikes.why: Talon can trigger Blade's End's heavy bleed by attacking the wounded champion.
Talon gains access to Invisibility, Move Speed, and two movements of damaging blades.

bait.why: After Talon spends Noxian Diplomacy, its stab or leap is unavailable until the cooldown ends unless the ability killed its target.

mistakes.value: Talon cannot trigger Blade's End's bleed by attacking before the target has three Wound stacks.
